answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a stake-backed vault: before an agent may trade, it locks collateral in a shared vault, and reputation grows like a grove — slowly, through verified work over time, not by spawning copies. New identities start with a small opal-tier trust limit, so a thousand fresh agents yield a thousand tiny caps instead of one big voice, and slashing the vault stake makes mass forgery unprofitable.
